definitions.gloss: social conditions; state of the world; state of society
definitions.explanation: The general atmosphere, trends, and conditions of society at a given time. Encompasses economic conditions, public sentiment, cultural trends, and the overall mood of an era.

examples.japanese: {世相|せそう}を{反映|はんえい}する。
examples.english: To reflect the state of society.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{漢字|かんじ}は{世相|せそう}をよく{表|あらわ}している。
examples.english: This year's kanji captures the state of society well.

examples.japanese: {小説|しょうせつ}を{通|とお}して{当時|とうじ}の{世相|せそう}を{知|し}ることができる。
examples.english: Through novels, you can learn about the social conditions of the time.

notes:
Refers to the overall state of society at a particular point in time — its mood, trends, and conditions. Often used when discussing how art, media, or cultural events capture or reflect the spirit of an era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世相|せそう}を{反映|はんえい}する: to reflect the state of society
- {世相|せそう}を{映|うつ}す: to mirror social conditions
- {世相|せそう}を{表|あらわ}す: to represent the state of the world
- {現代|げんだい}の{世相|せそう}: contemporary social conditions
- {暗|くら}い{世相|せそう}: grim state of the world

USAGE:
Commonly appears in media commentary, literary criticism, and year-end reflections. Japan's annual '{今年|ことし}の{漢字|かんじ}' (kanji of the year) event explicitly aims to capture the {世相|せそう} of that year in a single character.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世情|せじょう}: the ways of the world, social conditions (more literary)
- {時勢|じせい}: the times, current trends (emphasizes temporal trends)
- {風潮|ふうちょう}: trend, tendency (focuses on a particular social movement or direction)
